notes.title: Announcing the Teaser Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

We’re excited to finally share the first official teaser for Slendrina: Escape Together, In this teaser, you’ll see how you ended up in the domain of the evil ghost Slendrina!

[previewyoutube=QQNq_dOWS-Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We thank everyone who adds our game to their wishlist, this means a lot to us, and we appreciate your support.

We also want to inform you that we plan to participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, where you will be able to play the demo version of our game

We also invite you to join our Discord server, where you can participate in the development of our game, and maybe we'll add what you specifically want to the game.
